scope.qfos: Bounded deterministic wave planning over verified pending directives; planning is not engine execution.
scope.qios: Unresolved identifier. No QIOS integration or compatibility claim is permitted without an external canonical definition.
scope.single_writer: Cooperating CLI processes sharing the same lexical state path must fail closed under an OS-backed sidecar lock.

cases.attack: Two processes load one snapshot concurrently and consume different directives.
cases.old_expected: Both can return success and the last rename can lose one consumed tombstone.
cases.new_required: At most one process owns the state lock; a later explicit retry preserves both tombstones and a valid snapshot.

cases.attack: Flood distinct directive IDs beyond the configured pending capacity.
cases.old_expected: All distinct IDs are inserted and persisted.
cases.new_required: The batch fails before state or report mutation; no partial prefix is committed.

cases.attack: Consume beyond the tombstone capacity to force unbounded replay-state growth.
cases.old_expected: Tombstones grow without a capacity decision.
cases.new_required: Consumption fails without removing the pending directive or mutating the persisted snapshot.

cases.attack: Restore a syntactically valid snapshot whose pending or consumed cardinality exceeds local limits.
cases.old_expected: The snapshot is accepted solely on schema, network and policy checks.
cases.new_required: Restoration fails before polling or output creation.

cases.attack: Declare more registry sessions than the hard fan-out limit and count transport hits.
cases.old_expected: Every declared session can be polled sequentially.
cases.new_required: Registry validation fails before any transport, state or report creation.

cases.attack: One high-cardinality source attempts to monopolize a QF-OS wave.
cases.new_required: Deterministic source round-robin, global and per-source quotas, explicit deferred accounting, and no ledger mutation.

cases.attack: Modify an admitted job, plan metadata or state binding after plan generation.
cases.new_required: An independent Python reconstruction rejects the modified plan and verifies the unmodified known-answer fixture.

cases.attack: Treat a plan or state digest as publisher authentication, execution proof or QIOS compatibility.
cases.old_expected: No explicit downgrade statement exists for wave plans.
cases.new_required: Documentation and schema mark the artifact plan-only; digest verification remains consistency checking, not authentication or execution proof.
